<svg viewBox="0 0 390 844" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.22"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="25" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="321" y1="20" x2="325" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="18" x2="332" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="16" x2="339" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="20" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="353" y1="23" x2="356" y2="26" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="14" width="21" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="366" y="16" width="15" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="386" y="18" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- back arrow -->
  <polyline points=" thirty" fill="none"/>
  <polyline points="31,65 21,75 31,85" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="75" x2="48" y2="75" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- tinder logo -->
  <g>
    <path d="M194 55 C184 65 180 75 183 86 C185 94 192 99 200 99 C211 99 219 91 219 80 C219 69 211 60 201 52 C202 61 199 67 194 72 C194 64 193 59 194 55Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="125" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="21" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF">tinder</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="188" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>
  <text x="195" y="213" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9">Choose a way to continue</text>

  <!-- Apple button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="56" y="246" width="278" height="44" rx="62" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M113 259 C108 259 106 263 106 268 C106 274 109 279 113 279 C116 279 117 277 120 277 C123 277 124 279 127 279 C131 279 134 274 135 270 C130 268 129 262 133 259 C131 257 128 256 126 256 C123 256 121 258 119 258 C117 258 115 256 113 259Z" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M122 254 C123 251 126 250 128 250 C128 253 126 255 123 256" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="274" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN WITH APPLE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Facebook button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="56" y="304" width="278" height="44" rx="62" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="113" cy="326" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <path d="M115 320 L115 326 L119 326 L118 330 L115 330 L115 337 L110 337 L110 330 L107 330 L107 326 L110 326 L110 322 C110 319 112 317 115 317 C117 317 119 318 120 318 L119 322 C118 321 117 320 115 320Z" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="195" y="332" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN WITH FACEBOOK</text>
  </g>

  <!-- phone button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="56" y="362" width="278" height="44" rx="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="108" y="374" width="11" height="19" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="113.5" cy="389.5" r="1" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="205" y="390" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">SIGN IN WITH PHONE NUMBER</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="80" y1="450" x2="310" y2="450" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.35"/>
  <text x="195" y="480" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9">New to Tinder?</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="90" y="493" width="210" height="44" rx="62" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="520" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">CREATE ACCOUNT</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="584" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">By signing in, you agree to our</text>
  <text x="195" y="604" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF" text-decoration="underline">Terms</text>
  <text x="234" y="604" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF">and</text>
  <text x="272" y="604" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF" text-decoration="underline">Privacy Policy</text>

  <text x="195" y="650" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF" text-decoration="underline">Trouble signing in?</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="84" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="760" x2="390" y2="760" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.18"/>

  <!-- discover -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,779 51,773 57,785 45,791" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="782" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="48" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">DISCOVER</text>
  </g>

  <!-- likes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="126" cy="781" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="121,781 125,785 132,777" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="126" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">LIKES</text>
  </g>

  <!-- matches -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="779" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="205" cy="783" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="199" y1="782" x2="201" y2="782" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="200" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">MATCHES</text>
  </g>

  <!-- messages -->
  <g>
    <rect x="270" y="774" width="20" height="14" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="274,788 274,792 279,788" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <circle cx="276" cy="781" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="282" cy="781" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="288" cy="781" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="280" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">MESSAGES</text>
  </g>

  <!-- profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="348" cy="779" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="777" r="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <ellipse cx="348" cy="784" rx="4.5" ry="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="348" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">PROFILE</text>
  </g>
</svg>
